name: platform.eved.com
description: Connects Eved platform to Anthropic tool

_published_faq.name: How do I add platform.eved.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add platform.eved.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://platform.eved.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the platform.eved.com MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: platform.eved.com provides these MCP tools: list_cost_centers, list_divisions, list_epc_approval_needed, list_epc_envelopes, list_epc_funding_statements, list_invoices, list_program_currencies, list_programs, list_purchase_orders, and list_wbs.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to platform.eved.com?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to platform.eved.com in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
platform.eved.com requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
platform.eved.com is developed by Eved Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
